Nice to meet you.
I really love the atmosphere and color palette of your work, so I’ve commissioned you to draw this.

■ Aki
A mysterious boy who has just moved to the misty town. He loves classical literature and rock music. He has multiple piercings in his ears and lips. He has a strange constitution where small scars occasionally appear.

■ Rika
The daughter of a long-established family in the town, she is a gentle and kind girl, yet somehow elusive. She helps out in the school nurse’s office and enjoys making specimens and studying the occult. She keeps a dream journal titled *The Black Rose Diary*.

■ World Setting
A small, isolated town shrouded in fog all year round. On the outskirts of town lie the ruins of a facility from the late Showa era, a place surrounded by mysterious rumors.

I look forward to working with you.

Hello~ Could you please draw my Original character "Ashar," as well as his two friends?

They all work in a mysterious office that exists in the void. All three of them come from different worlds, but have become friends despite their background differences.

I'd like it if you could draw them in any cute friendship pose that might be expected in an office - looking at a computer screen together, sharing a meal in the cafeteria, trying coffee, etc. Or simply posed together and smiling is fine too!! 

Ashar (Please note he is tan, has a mole beneath his mouth.)
A kind and easygoing botanist from a desert planet with little resources. As a result, he doesn't know what fish are... he is new to how water is so readily available in this office he has found himself transported to. 

Marine: (Blonde hair)
A french woman from 1980s France, she has controlling parents and wishes to be a forensic pathologist. Despite her kind appearance, sweet personality, and socially awkward demeanor, she actually really enjoys horror!

Ethan: (Blue hair)
A man from a futuristic world where cyborgs have wiped out human life and nuclear winter has set in. Both his legs are prosthetics, and due to his past experiences, he's a rather difficult and cranky individual to get along with. However, with both Marine and Ashar being rather harmless and friendly, he manages to be a little more at ease around them. Although he tends to be self-deprecatory, he's not above a smile when he is with them both.


Marine and Ethan References:
https://imgur.com/a/eWFk4qj

Ashar References:

初めまして。以前友人から今回リクエストさせていただきました TRPGのオリジナルキャラクターを再度KnD様に描いていただきたくリクエストさせていただきました。所謂うちよそになります。

── 
OC詳細

■ヴィクター・フォン・レオ（目隠れ金髪の方）
29歳177cm 獅子座、ギャンブラー。博打好き。元は由緒正しい家柄の出で所作に品が残っている。 ザミエルのことは鬱陶しいが唯一無二の相手だと感じている。趣味は美術品集め。直感で動くタイプ。表情を読まれないようにするために前髪を伸ばしている。倫理観はまともな方。ザミエルのやること全てを許すし共犯者にもなると思っている。攻め。

以下言いそう、言ってる台詞
「今日の俺はついてるな」
「お前、なんでここにいるんだよ(呆れ)」
「だから俺は別に普通だって言ってるだろうが」


■ザミエル・G・サジタリウス（仮面の方）
33歳195㎝射手座、仮面の不審男。でかい。明るく朗らかだが、基本何もかもを煙に巻く。元軍人の殺し屋。 ヴィクターに興味がありいつも周りをニコニコついて回ってはウザがられているが、ヴィクターからの不意打ちに弱い。従軍時にできた大きな傷が顔に残っている。目的のためなら手段は選ばないタイプ。紅茶が好き。受け。

以下言いそう、言ってる台詞
「アナタのその体に興味があります」
「どういう表情をしてると思いますか」
「ヴィクターさん、アナタは本当に面白い人だ」

関係性としては友人を経て交際関係になります。

構図についてはおまかせします。服装やヘアアレンジ等も好きにしていただいて構いません。ザミエルは仮面の有無の差分を希望しますが難しいようでしたら無くても大丈夫です…！

使用用途としては
SNSのアイコンやヘッダー、PCの壁紙、個人利用の範囲でのグッズ化に使用させてもらう可能性があります。

── 
ご検討のほど、よろしくお願いいたします。

knD,

Nice to meet you. My name is Miyatoki.
I’ve been wanting to commission you ever since I first saw your work on Skeb, so I’m reaching out with a request.

I’d like you to draw illustrations of my two original characters (OCs).

OC #1
Name: Natsuki Samejima
25 years old, male, 186 cm tall, detective
Dark brown hair and eyes

He’s a career officer with the rank of Inspector.
He comes from an elite family with many relatives in the police force and other government service. Although his parents were strict, he grew up freely as the second son.
He has no unpleasant traits; he’s friendly and the type of model student everyone likes.
Aside from having a chronic illness that limits his stamina, he has no particular weaknesses and handles everything competently.
Because he believes his condition will prevent him from continuing his career for long, he gives his all to his duties.

OC②
Name: Yoshitaka Kujirai
35 years old, male, 179 cm, Detective
Black hair, black eyes (no highlights)

A non-career officer with the rank of Assistant Inspector. He is hardworking and has advanced relatively quickly through the ranks.
He is ordinary and average in every respect. He’s a jack-of-all-trades but master of none. While he has no standout talents, he has worked hard and studied diligently.
His parents were busy and paid little attention to him, so he was raised by his grandparents. After dating his first girlfriend—whom he met in college—for five years, he discovered she was cheating on him. Since the breakup, he has felt uncomfortable around women.

Their Relationship
Buddies. Kujii finds it difficult to work with his younger superior, but Samejima is very fond of him.
They trust each other, and Kujii, setting aside his professional reservations, cares deeply for Samejima, who gives his all to everything he does.


Please feel free to choose the composition and situation.
Please refer to the URL for reference materials. Since these images were created for reference purposes, the appearance and clothing do not need to match the images exactly.

Nishinomiya Ritsu (179cm) A 25-year-old black-haired man. He inherited a pirate crew disguised as a maritime theater troupe and became its new troupe leader. While nominally touring the seas as a theater company, their true purpose is treasure hunting. During one such expedition, he was discovered by Yasukawa Sei, a newly emerged pirate. Nishinomiya used a map as leverage to coerce Yasukawa into joining his crew. Beyond his pirate duties, Nishimiya also has him perform on stage alongside him, holding Yasukawa in high regard. As both troupe leader and pirate captain, Nishimiya excels in both acting and combat, but is extremely clumsy emotionally. A 27-year-old man with brown hair. An adventurer who set sail driven by a passion for treasure hunting, eventually becoming a pirate. However, shortly after setting sail, he encountered a troublesome opponent. Learning that Nishimiya possessed the treasure map he'd long dreamed of, he reluctantly joined his pirate crew. His goal is to steal the map and escape safely. Yasukawa is energetic and kind-hearted, but he's harbored resentment towards Nishimiya's threatening attitude from the start. When he discovered the boss harbored feelings for him, he was shocked and refused to acknowledge it. Consequently, he ignores all advances from Nishimiya, though he handles business matters properly. I'd love to see interactions between this ill-matched CP. I would appreciate it if you could draw it using the image at the link below as a reference.
